FFO to debt of {{ffo_to_debt@FY2025}} and FCF to debt of {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}} are both in line with the peer medians of {{ffo_to_debt.peer_median@2025}} and {{fcf_to_debt.peer_median@2025}}.

snapshot.text: Norwegian Air Shuttle, a low-cost carrier in the Nordic market, grew revenue by {{revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{revenue@FY2025}} in FY2025 while the EBITDA margin widened by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}}.

The earnings gain did not translate into deleveraging: net leverage rose by {{net_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{net_leverage@FY2025}} as net debt increased by {{net_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{net_debt@FY2025}}.

The main point to watch is liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, the weakest of the low-cost peer group ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@2025}}).

watch_items.text: Leverage: net leverage rose by {{net_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{net_leverage@FY2025}} while gross leverage held at {{gross_leverage@FY2025}}, so further debt-funded investment would leave little room at the peer median.

Cash generation: free cash flow fell by {{fcf.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf@FY2025}} and FCF to debt by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}}, with capex intensity of {{capex_intensity@FY2025}} above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@2025}}.

Customer prepayments: contract liabilities of {{contract_liabilities@FY2025}} rose by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2025}}, so a bookings slowdown would reduce the cash buffer that advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}} represents.
